$comment: Initial JS per route in kB gzip (scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs, F15.2): the entry chunk, the route's lazy chunk, every chunk they import statically, and any worker/asset script one of those chunks starts eagerly (MapLibre's worker). Compressed at gzip level 1, the nginx default frontend/nginx.conf actually serves at (it sets gzip on without gzip_comp_level) -- not level 9, which under-reports by roughly 10-15%. Budgets are the measured size at S0-FE plus about 10% headroom; lower them when a stream makes a route lighter. `target` records the intended budget once the named work lands.

/.note: S7-SEO: the shell grew ~1.8 kB (seven lazy route entries for /du-an, /khu-vuc, /tin-tuc and the prerendered-head reset); areas/projects/articles on the home page load in their own chunk (features/places/HomeExtras). Budget = measured + ~3 kB. W6-UX (2026-10-03): shell +~0.5 kB (137.7 -> 138.2 kB): DS-06 tall-header hook (header stops being sticky when enlarged text makes it cover a quarter of the window), DS-04 focusable scrolling dialog body, DS-03 44 px label targets and 14 px action text, DS-08 SearchBox/Gallery states. Budget +1 kB; reduction owned by S10-PERF.

/search.target: S2 Review 2: <=130 kB is not reachable at the gzip-1 metric. The shell alone is 120.0 kB, leaving 10 kB for the route, while the code a list page cannot render without (ListingCard + TrustBadge 5.0, filterSchema URL parsing 3.5, listingPath/labels 1.4, LoadMore 0.6, API 0.3) already weighs 10.8 kB before the route's own 8.3 kB (search box, chips, sort, paging hook). MapLibre, the filter form/sheet, the zero-result/error states and the map point sheet all load on demand. Measured at the gzip-9 metric the target was set with, /search is 125.6 kB (under 130). Budget = best achieved (140.6) + 1.4 kB; lowering the shell (not S2) is the remaining lever.
